description: This file defines the application theme settings for a Flutter app, including light and dark themes, custom color schemes, and a theme controller to switch themes at runtime. It encapsulates styling details like colors, shapes, and transitions to ensure a consistent visual appearance across the app.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: Defines static methods and constants to generate ThemeData objects for light and dark themes, encapsulating color schemes, typography, and widget themes.

classes.name: AppThemeController
classes.description: Provides an implementation to manage and persist the current ThemeMode (light, dark, system) with runtime switching capability.

methods.name: _base
methods.description: Builds a ThemeData object based on a given ColorScheme, establishing visual styles for various UI components.

methods.name: lightTheme
methods.description: Returns the ThemeData configured for light mode, using a custom ColorScheme.

methods.name: darkTheme
methods.description: Returns the ThemeData configured for dark mode, using a custom ColorScheme.

methods.name: setThemeMode
methods.description: Updates the ThemeMode and notifies listeners to trigger UI updates.

methods.name: loadInitialThemeMode
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the persisted theme mode from shared preferences, defaulting to system.
